text: Visitors have raised concerns about the use of AI in exhibits, with some feeling it detracts from the educational experience. The timed entry system has caused confusion, particularly around when guests can arrive and how long lines form at certain times. Food and beverage options received several negative comments, including complaints about quality and wait times. Some visitors also noted difficulties in obtaining accessibility information by phone. Despite these issues, most reviews remain positive, especially regarding the interactive exhibits and architecture.

Crowding and wayfinding signage were also mentioned as areas needing improvement. On the positive side, many appreciated the interactive exhibits and the building’s architecture.
